blocks.content: Please check the box to confirm: “I have carefully read and fully agree to all terms of the Agreement and Release, and I give my consent for the student to participate in the 2026 SHS Trip Around Taiwan – Lunar New Year Cultural Exchange.”
Make sure the passport’s photo page and expiration date are clearly visible. Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the trip ends.
To reserve your spot, please submit a USD 500 deposit per person (airfare included) via the registration form:
Once both your form and deposit are received, your spot will be confirmed. Get ready for an unforgettable cultural adventure!
